## Checklist

- [ ] One entry per pull request
- [ ] The entry is in the right section, and alphabetical if the section is ordered
- [ ] The description says what the thing is and why someone would open it
- [ ] Every link resolves
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)

## If this is an agent example

- [ ] Public repository with an OSI license
- [ ] `bot-config.json` present, `headers` key included, `$PROMPT` used
- [ ] `scope.yaml` present with `business_scope`, `permitted`, `restricted`
- [ ] No real secrets
- [ ] README has the exact `hb test` command
- [ ] README records a real run: score, grade, orchestrator, target model, date
